criteria.rationale: Verified: the three reading callers only display or label an issuer (cli review_run_provenance.go:76, delegated_verdicts.go:345, review_conclusions.go:510), and new-verdict paths stay live (review_conclusions.go:568, delegated_review_request.go:300, delegated_verdicts.go:428). Unresolved: expiry behaviour has no test (N1). Accepted risk: the adjudication/smoke gate stays live (N3).

Examined cmdReviewRunProof: same usage, output shape and exit codes. Only the verdict changes, for done scopes (it now agrees with the closeout), which the spec's API/contract section and the manual declare. VerifyReviewRunProof is unchanged for its other callers.

Cause: the readers called the live verifier while the closeout used the sealed one for done scopes. The new function reuses the closeout's own predicate (runApprovalAsSealed), so the two cannot diverge (R1). D1 drops expiry only on the reading path.

criteria.rationale: Compared the four manual copies: EN root and dist are identical, pt-BR root and dist are identical. They describe the sealed/live dispatch and why expiry is skipped, matching review_run_provenance.go:665-681. Minor spec wording issue in N2.
Errors on both paths keep the existing 'run provenance: ...' messages, rendered by the CLI as 'pose review run proof: ...'. The fallback to live surfaces the live reason.

Code changes are limited to the declared affected areas and artifacts. Conclusion paths are left live, as the constraints require. The only code addition outside R1-R3 is the R1-F4 hardening on the sealed path.

The sealed path still checks signature, pin, project/audience and run binding (verifyRunProofCore) and that the record stands. It now refuses a symlinked proof directory (:593). An unreadable bundle falls back to the stricter live check. No reading answer grants authority for a new attestation.

Smallest sufficient fix: one 10-line dispatcher reusing the existing predicate and verifiers, plus three call-site swaps. No new abstraction. This choice is invalidated if a caller ever uses the reading result to authorize a new attestation (D1 falsifier), and no caller does today.
